description: Canonical signed action envelope. Executors MUST validate every field before acting. No executor accepts shell text, JS, or free-form instructions.

approval_ref.description: Approval ID when policy requires one. Null for R0/R1 auto-allowed actions.

args.description: Parameterized arguments validated against the capability schema. Never free-form code.

expected_effect.description: Post-state predicates the executor verifies after acting.

idempotency_key.description: job_id:step_N — duplicate deliveries with the same key produce one effect and one linked receipt.

preconditions.description: Named preconditions the executor must verify immediately before acting.

signature.description: Core signature over the canonical envelope. Executors reject unsigned envelopes.

title: Operator Action Envelope
